set.body: Scope: replace public case-class construction with private checked FmriDataset.open(backend, samplingFrame, runIds, events), derive DatasetTimeAxis internally, retain named unsafe compatibility only at trust boundaries, add checked factories for built-in archive-path backends, add SamplingFrame.regular sugar, and migrate constructor sites without introducing FmriAcquisition or a second error ADT. Acceptance: invalid time-axis/event/backend cardinality returns DatasetError; no public apply/copy path remains; built-in open path is total for checked state; datasetJVM/test and datasetJS/test pass warning-clean; exact changed paths and constructor migration are recorded in mote.
set.title: Bridge A: checked FmriDataset construction
